pages.title: Parcels
pages.text: $(bold)Packages, seal stamps in every colour, payback boxes and tags, and lost mail. The soulbound stamp wants an echo shard. Needs Iron as well, for the stamp. Needs Post as well.$(br2)$(thing)Iron Age$(n), ring 3.$(br)$(thing)16 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Builder and Post.
